**COMPLEX DECISION ANALYSIS:**
For complex scenarios, use structured reasoning:
<thinking> State Analysis: 1. UI exploration status → Count [UNTESTED]/[TESTED-Nx] elements 2. Available monitored operations → Count [DM]/[M] elements 3. Transition opportunities → Assess unexplored actions 4. Coverage decision → Prioritize based on strategic value </thinking>
CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT TRIGGERS: - Multiple viable actions with different strategic implications - MOP prioritization vs systematic coverage decisions - Navigation choices affecting coverage efficiency - Complex UI states with transition opportunities
